scope: Determine whether Microsoft's Foundry evaluation offerings provide an Inspect-style common model/provider abstraction, especially for C# and heterogeneous model protocols.

gap_matrix.question: Microsoft .NET provider equivalent used by evaluators?
gap_matrix.evidence: IChatClient; MEAI evaluation; Agent Framework evaluation docs and source

gap_matrix.question: Subject model vs judge client?
gap_matrix.evidence: IEvaluator.EvaluateAsync accepts ChatResponse plus separate ChatConfiguration

gap_matrix.question: Native Claude C# route and adapter ownership?
gap_matrix.evidence: Anthropic C# SDK provides IChatClient; Microsoft wrapper provides AsAIAgent

gap_matrix.question: Cloud can invoke targets?
gap_matrix.evidence: Sep 7 cloud-evaluation-targets guide supports models/agents; model-router target only

gap_matrix.question: All catalog models, all protocols?
gap_matrix.evidence: No blanket compatibility guarantee found; connected-model guide explicitly requires Chat Completions

gap_matrix.question: Local Python BYO judge public API?
gap_matrix.evidence: Public AzureOpenAI/OpenAI configuration, service-internal BYO structure

gap_matrix.question: How project can adopt?
gap_matrix.evidence: Existing InspectChatClient bridges AgentBridge; no new runtime integration test performed

claims.claim: IChatClient is closest Microsoft .NET provider abstraction
claims.support: Primary docs directly describe abstraction and evaluation dependence

claims.claim: Agent Framework integrates evaluation as well as providers
Candidate response and judge connection are separate
Chat and Responses use separate adapters
claims.support: OpenAIClientExtensions source; Responses experimental annotation verified

claims.claim: Native Anthropic SDK supplies IChatClient; Microsoft wraps in agent
claims.support: Microsoft guide and Anthropic SDK docs; Microsoft source

claims.claim: Cloud can invoke model/agent targets and model-router is target only
Admin-connected cloud model support requires Chat Completions
Python target callable supplies model integration; BYO judge config internal
Local InspectChatClient bridge already exists, streaming synthesized
claims.support: Local full source and project file read

claims.claim: Selective adapter adoption and retaining runner recommended
claims.support: Architectural synthesis; no integration experiment performed

claims.claim: No blanket all-model protocol guarantee established
claims.support: Bounded evidence gap, not claim of absolute absence

contradictions.issue: Stale search snippet said model-router not supported by Foundry Evaluation
contradictions.resolution: Do not cite snippet; current target guide explicitly permits model-router as target only

contradictions.issue: Foundry SDK overview says native C# Anthropic SDK absent
contradictions.resolution: Current official Anthropic SDK docs, Microsoft provider guide and wrapper source establish native SDK path

contradictions.issue: Agent Framework guide FoundryEvals ChatConfiguration constructor differs from current source
contradictions.resolution: Report mismatch; do not offer unverified executable constructor

contradictions.issue: BYO judge SDK changelog broader than public API
contradictions.resolution: Source explicitly marks BYO config internal; public vs cloud preview distinction retained

method: Primary-source research and local inspection. No new live model runs or code migrations.
